themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents capable of performing complex, autonomous tasks in research settings, from data analysis to conducting interviews.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Content focusing on specific AI-powered tools and platforms designed to aid researchers in various stages of their work, such as data collection, analysis, and synthesis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles detailing AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, debugging, and optimizing code.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Discussions on how AI is being applied to creative processes in design and user research, including image generation, UI design, and concept generation.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Explores the use of AI chatbots for research purposes, including their capabilities, limitations, and impact on user interactions and mental health.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text into concise summaries, aiding in information processing and research.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Articles examining how AI is affecting jobs, skills requirements, and the overall employment landscape, with a focus on research and development roles.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating, augmenting, or analyzing usability testing processes and results.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Articles discussing how AI is used to extract, analyze, and interpret customer data to derive actionable insights.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Covers platforms and ecosystems built around AI that facilitate various aspects of scientific and market research.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
